If by EM reactor you mean a deamon which consumes the EM configuration, then this daemon doesn't consume configuration but inventory data. As stated in design the purpose of this daemon is -

1. Get -- Expected Connected Cables -- from --> cable-config.json
2. Get -- Cable Inventory ------------ from --> EntityManager
3. Diff = #2 minus #1
4. Generate Cable events for Diff in Step3.
5. Generate/Resolve the CableEvents based on Cable Inventory changes.

Currently, in EM there is no way to specify #1, but there is for #2 and thats where #2 will be specified (in Meta case via GPIO HW Inventory for cables).
